decisions.reason: The reference electrometer sits at the core of the firm's dosimetry business, is featured prominently on the home page, and represents a visible commitment that management would not write off.
The risk management software fits the announced direction of integration, automation and prediction, so the investment and public positioning make persistence likely even if uptake is slow.
The CT phantom was launched only recently, extends the established imaging QA line, and has its own page, so any weak early results can be put down to the start-up phase.
Although mammography is distant from the core, the product is new and publicly presented, and dropping it after one year would expose the diversification decision as premature.
It overlaps with the other mammography phantom, which makes consolidation conceivable, but its recent launch and dedicated presentation favour giving it more time.
The broad imaging QA instrument line builds on established capabilities and supports the firm's expansion, so it is a committed course of action.
